params.body:
A pass over the pages the owner walked through, each item from a screenshot of what was unclear.

**Overview**
- **Collect:** the day's count is neutral. Broken sources get their own line in amber, in the right number ("1 source is not collecting"), instead of the whole line in red.
- **Suggest:** "12 born, 25 folded, 87 lapsed in 24h. Budget shut: 12 born today, the budget is 12" is now "Last 24 hours: 12 new, 25 merged into existing ones, 87 expired. Today's limit of new drafts is reached." The count reads "draft trends".
- **Vocabulary line:** "Of the 980 new concepts named in week 37, 11.3% were used again later. The higher, the more the system reuses its words instead of inventing new ones." The pale bars are explained as recent weeks.
- **Live activity:** "Listening for pipeline activity..." now says what the strip is and that nothing new has come in since the page opened.

**Geography**
- Subject regions are grouped under their wider region from the Standard's region tree (Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific, Africa and Middle East). A group opens on a click; Global stays on its own.
- Each panel says what it counts: subject is where what a signal is about happens, source is where the reporting source is based.

**Foresight**
- The title and the intro now say what an element is and what is compared.
- "Tag health" becomes "How the tagging is going", with its numbers in a sentence. The empty state says why nothing shows yet.

**Mix**
- The intro and the footnote use the full width.
- Changes against the period before are bold, green when up and amber when down. The kept share and the cited count are bold.

**Settings**
- The spaced-capital subtitles are plain sentences, here and on Analytics, Graph, Chat, Evals and Earned autonomy. The tab-level line that repeated each section's own subtitle is gone.
- Team rows sit on a fixed grid, so "admin" lines up whether or not the row can be removed. The team text names gentells.com.
- "Probe token" becomes "Read-only access key", with what it is for, what it cannot do and that it expires. The button is "Make a key", no longer red.

**Everywhere**
- Underline tabs and header buttons are square, so underlines no longer curve at the ends.
- The current page in every pager is ink with white text. Reports used a colour token that does not exist, so its number was invisible.
- The items on the right of the header share one box, so they line up.

Checked: `npm run build`, e2e 27 passing.
params.title: Observatory: plain words and straight lines across overview, geography, foresight, mix, settings
